answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, an AI agent economy enforces hardware-bound proof-of-physical-attestation. Each agent routes its cryptographic credentials through an optical prism attestation layer, binding its state to non-reproducible magnetic variations in its host machine's ferrous silicon. An attacker attempting to flood the agent garden with fake nodes must purchase distinct physical chips rather than virtualizing instances. This imposes prohibitive capital expenditures, making large-scale identity spoofing mathematically and economically unviable.
